provenance.source: real-host bugs on Pi: an autocorrect notice after a shortcut expansion with autocorrect off; notices that never left the screen, including the host-menu notice after the menu closed
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: A shortcut expansion with no autocorrect loaded says it was a shortcut, never 'Autocorrect:'.

notices: Shortcut expanded: Backspace or Undo restores what you typed.

cases.note: A notice about the draft being written is gone from the status once that draft is sent; the session log keeps it.

notices: Shortcut expanded: Backspace or Undo restores what you typed.

cases.note: The 'host menu or dialog is open' notice never stays on screen after the host menu closes.

notices: Murmo: host menu or dialog is open; ghost accept and edits are deferred until it closes.
